title: feat: add Claude Sonnet 5.5 via AWS Bedrock
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15832

- Adds `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` through AWS Bedrock in `us-east-1`, using `global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`. No aliases; paid-only; multiplier 1; no Pollinations GPU. Supports text/image input, tools, adaptive reasoning, 1M context, and a 128K output budget.
- Uses global-standard AWS Marketplace rates verified against the active agreement for `prod-pjfguoisodbd6`: $2 input, $10 output, $0.20 cache read, and $2.50 five-minute cache write per million tokens. Pricing snapshot updated.
- Passed direct AWS invocation and authenticated local E2E: Chat Completions and Messages streaming/non-streaming, native text, vision/multiple images, tool round-trip, reasoning, stop, small output limits, paid-only enforcement, output cache, prompt cache, and malformed-input errors. Four concurrent requests passed (recent peak: two/second); 860,055 input tokens with `max_tokens=128000` completed in 33.5 seconds.
- Reconciled 22 billed events with provider usage, AWS attribution, and wallet debits: 1.8466242 Pollen total; no missing conversion rates. Both service typechecks, formatting, 186 focused model tests, and the pricing snapshot passed. Local Gen Workers pool fails before execution; focused tests used the Node runner. CI remains the full-suite gate.
- Bedrock rejects structured output and forced tools; neither is advertised. Responses API returns its unsupported-model 400. No fallback configured: candidate: OpenRouter's pinned `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` Anthropic endpoint, declined for its 5.5% fee.

[AWS model documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-5.html)

gist.headline: A bigger reading nook
gist.blurb: Claude Sonnet 5.5 has joined the model shelf. It can take in a million tokens, look at images, and use tools; apparently the shelf needed reinforcing.
gist.summary: Added paid-only `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` through AWS Bedrock to Chat Completions and Messages, with text and image input, tool use, adaptive reasoning, a 1M-token context window, and a 128K-token output budget.
gist.impact: Paid users can select `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` for streaming or non-streaming chats with long context, images, and tools; the Responses API is not supported for this model.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the new model as a roomy reading nook connected to a retro API terminal, with a very long paper scroll for its 1M-token context and small picture and tool icons for its inputs and capabilities. Polli, wearing tiny reading glasses, studies the scroll beside an eager CRT monitor robot; code-plants grow around them.
